completeCurrentCard.name: Protection from Energy

operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range and line of effect, including yourself.
operational.duration: If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count.
operational.effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, force, necrotic or radiant. The target is immune to damage of that one type for the duration.
operational.limitations: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, poison, psychic and Corruption are not selectable energy types here. One Protection from Energy per target across all casters: a later application replaces the old type and owns its own deadline; stale cleanup cannot erase the replacement. Immunity blocks only the selected damage, not attached conditions or riders unless those independently require positive damage. It does not undo resolved damage or protect against a transferred post-defense branch expressly skipping a second mitigation/prevention stage. A magical weapon's physical damage remains physical. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
